name: Self-service dev deployment of gpt-4.1-mini (policy auto-approval)
description: A developer deploys gpt-4.1-mini with 10k TPM GlobalStandard capacity on the dev Foundry resource. The request matches the registry's auto_approve condition (dev + Global/DataZone Standard + capacity ≤ 10), so `.submit` approves it and the execute workflow logs in to Azure with OIDC, runs the `az` pre-flight and deploys the Bicep template.
